name: claude-code-templates
description: CLI tool for configuring and monitoring Claude Code
one_liner: A library of ready-made settings, AI helper agents, and shortcuts that developers install into Claude Code with one command, instead of configuring it from scratch.
buyer: A solo developer or small dev team using Claude Code who wants proven agent and command setups (code review, testing, security checks) instead of writing custom prompts.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer installs the 'code-reviewer' and 'test-generator' templates to speed up client projects without writing custom prompts.
A dev-tools agency uses the built-in analytics dashboard to monitor Claude Code usage across a client's engineering team.
A coding bootcamp instructor has every student install a standardized set of templates so every student's AI coding setup is consistent.

money_ideas.idea: Sell premium, curated template bundles for specific stacks (e.g. a full Next.js + Stripe SaaS starter set of agents/commands) beyond the free catalog.
Offer a hosted, team-wide analytics and monitoring dashboard for Claude Code usage as a paid tier for engineering managers.

steal_this: Package a tight, opinionated bundle of 5-10 templates for one specific job (e.g. 'Shopify app developer') and sell it as a $19 one-time pack this weekend.
